headline: South African Reserve Bank Holds Repo Rate at 7.25% in Split Vote
summary: The South African Reserve Bank kept its benchmark repo rate steady at 7.25%. A split vote among Monetary Policy Committee members highlighted concerns over rising fuel costs and inflation risks.
why: The SARB sets monetary policy for Africa's most industrialized economy, balancing elevated inflation risks against sluggish economic growth.

impacts.name: South African Rand
impacts.why: The rand held steady as a split MPC vote signaled potential hawkishness ahead if inflation risks persist.
